conventions: Research lifecycle profile: stable IDs, source-scoped assertions, mandatory provenance, terminal conclusions.

Experiment.description: A bounded research test with a frozen success bar.

Gate.description: A measurable criterion used to accept, promote, or reject an experiment.

Decision.description: A dated terminal or promotion decision.

Lesson.description: A reusable conclusion supported by completed research.

Strategy.description: A candidate, live, killed, or retired strategic approach.

tested_by.description: Subject strategy or hypothesis is tested by object experiment.

evaluated_by.description: Subject experiment or strategy is evaluated by object gate.

concluded_by.description: Subject experiment is concluded by object decision or lesson.

killed_by.description: Subject strategy was terminated by object decision.

promoted_by.description: Subject strategy was promoted by object decision.

produced.description: Subject experiment or decision produced object lesson.
